findings: The due-zero source case first pauses QEMU, advances QTest virtual time to the existing deadline, and verifies that all eight requests remain pending. It is not a previously completed timer mislabeled as due.

Two stopped source snapshots before save and a complete after-save snapshot must be identical; pre-save cannot hide an acknowledgement. The actual 152-byte payload is compared with all serialized source observations.

The incoming target begins with distinct request and external-stall state. It uses a different virtual origin. The first restored observation is pure QOM plus RAM witness with explicit no SBM MMIO/no cont guards.
Eight restored active deadlines are checked at individual -1/+1 boundaries before the first SBM MMIO; the source zero remainder is observed pending before cont and completes only after dispatch.

The second destination proves active reconnect completion without finishing a stalled port, then resumes the stored 600 ns phase. A canceled stalled port remains idle. These timer proofs precede the first SBM MMIO.
Reset has an independent GCC register witness plus drained QMP RESET event; the test preserves the external stall input and rejects late responses.

The section parser binds the actual qcom-noc-sbm version-1 instance and checks every payload byte. The disabled source explicitly uses the canonical zero runtime invariant, while acknowledging runtime QOM is unavailable.
Both profile failures use real source files and started incoming processes, require the specific device/load error and target-versus-source marker direction, and preserve the source file hash.

Each corrupted file starts from the verified real source section and changes one bit in one field only: identity at byte40, or port1 remaining at byte72 from100 to1124. Whole-file byte differences and exact rejection diagnostics are retained.

Mapped invalid sizes and unaligned fragments use core size errors; unmapped holes remain core rejected errors. Wide commands explicitly permit the first four-byte transaction before the subsequent hole fails.
The main report requires exactly28 distinct successful checks, two completed and resumed roundtrips, two profile failures, two malformed-stream failures, and unchanged QEMU binary bytes.
limits: Static review is not an executed acceptance result. Formal CI must supply the actual QMP, QTest, stream and stderr artifacts.
The third saved unknown-profile source is a negative fixture and is not counted as another completed source-to-destination roundtrip.
Reference feedback has no physical traffic/drain/IRQ/Clock or userspace/Android success claim.
